name: Cape Town
full: Cape Town — Hout Bay, Philadelphia & the city
terroir: The Cape Town WO district, demarcated June 2017, unifies four wards under one appellation banner spanning the peninsula and the city itself: Constantia and Durbanville, and Hout Bay and Philadelphia, plus a handful of producers the district holds in no demarcated ward at all.
